project.name: ensap-reactor
project.description: ENSAP aggregator/reactor POM (master spec §37 Phase 3). Pure aggregator — it is NOT the Maven <parent> of any module below, so every module keeps building standalone via its own mvnw exactly as before. Its only job is to let `mvn install` here build every module in dependency order in one shot, which is what lets deployment-service and evidence-audit-service resolve the shared/event-contracts dependency without a separate manual install step.
